title: Dealer Retail Agreements Onboarding Standard: Approval, Starting Tier and Termination
content:
A dealership is approved under the Dealer Retail Agreements only when every item of the approval requirements is on file, including a current state dealer license; it starts at the starting tier. The standard is the same for every Dealer Program tier.

## 1. Approval requirements

The documents required before a dealer agreement is approved are:

| Approval requirement | Required |
|---|---|
| State dealer license | Yes |
| Surety bond | Yes |
| Garage liability certificate | Yes |
| W-9 | Yes |
| Voided operating-account check | Yes |
| Principal identification | Yes |

Whether a current state dealer license must be on file to fund contracts: yes (true for every tier).

## 2. Starting tier

The program tier assigned to a newly approved dealer is Dealer Program Bronze.

## 3. Ending the agreement

3.1 Either party may end the agreement without cause on 30 calendar days' written notice.

3.2 The agreement is terminated at once on any of the termination triggers: confirmed dealer fraud; suspension uncured after review; dealer closed business.

3.3 Termination stops new fundings but never cancels chargebacks or holdbacks already owed on funded contracts, which are settled under their own rules.

## 4. Agreement statuses at onboarding and termination

| From | To | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Pending approval | Active | Dealer onboarding documents are verified and the agreement is approved at the starting tier. |
| Pending approval | Terminated | The application is withdrawn or declined. |
| Active | Terminated | A termination trigger occurs or either party ends the agreement on notice. |
| On watch | Terminated | A termination trigger occurs while on watch. |
| Suspended | Terminated | The suspension is not cured at review or a termination trigger occurs. |

These are system transitions. Approval opens funding; termination sets the agreement to terminated with its termination date.

## 5. Points of judgement

- **Approval file complete.** All six approval requirements on file, the state dealer license current: the dealership may be approved, and it starts at Dealer Program Bronze.
- **Approval file incomplete.** Any one of the six missing — for example the garage liability certificate — or a state dealer license that is not current: the "only when every item" condition is unmet and the dealership is not approved.
- **Notice without cause.** Either party, the dealer or the company, may end the agreement on 30 calendar days' written notice; no cause is required.
- **After termination.** A chargeback already owed on a funded contract, or a holdback still held on one, remains in place after termination and is settled under its own rule; what termination stops is new fundings.
